item.blurb: Manicule Raises $1.3M Seed. Manicule raises $1.3 million in seed funding co-led by Y Combinator and Broom Ventures to expand its AI agent relations platform for software discovery.
Loamy Raises $6M Seed. Loamy raises $6M in seed funding led by Zeal Capital Partners to scale its agentic AI operations platform for the food supply chain.
Circuit Mind Raises $18.5M Series A. Circuit Mind raises $18.5M in Series A funding led by Norwest to expand its AI-powered electronic circuit design and verification platform.
Easol Raises $30M Series A Extension. Easol raises $30M in a Series A extension round to scale its experience commerce platform and launch its new agentic AI solution, Teammates.

Numeracle Raises $28M Other. Numeracle raises $28 million led by Edison Partners to expand its business identity verification and anti-spam communication platform internationally.
